general_information.Description: In this course, students are introduced fundamental understanding about strategic communication by approaching from definitions to current case studies. A range of important elements of strategic communication such as strategy concept, messages, stakholders, media, etc. are listed and well described. Also, students will comprehend the importance of research before creating strategies and plans. The role of strategic communication in branding and campaigns is highlighted. Ethics and societal issues have a strong impact while we are practicing strategic communication. Additionally, students will discuss about current changes in digital media industry and society so that they can adjust their strategic communication plans become more appropriate. Last but not least, students will know how to act ethically and professionally, and be accountable when professionally applying strategic communication in real life
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain fundamental knowledge about strategic communication, the concept of strategy, three management levels of strategic communication, the ethics and societal issues in strategic communication.
Reasearch and develop plans for strategic communication which require in-depth understanding of objectices, strategies, and tactics.
Comprehend the stakholders, message tactics, and different media including traditional and digital media which significantly involve with strategic communication.
Effectively apply strategic communication in branding and campaigns, well estimate time, budget, and accuratly evaluate the results.
Recognise significant changes in society and the tendency of media industry then predict and appropriately adjust strategic communication plans.
Demonstrate a professional and positive attitude, and be accountable when professionally applying strategic communication in real life

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

assessments.Question Type: Report: An in-depth analysis of a business/brand that suceesfully developed and implemtented strategic communication. (Lecturer offer specific case-studies or students can pick by themselves)
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Possess the necessary skills and abilities to develop and implement effective public relations plans for a wide range of entertainment activities. - Use AI to assist the assignment
assessments.Grading Guide: Suggested criteria for grading assignments as follows: (a) Briefly research the business/brand (2 marks) (b) Identify management levels (1.25 marks) (c) Identify strategies (1.5 marks) (d) Identify stakeholders (1.25 marks) (e) Evaluate message tactics (1.25 marks) (f) Evaluate ethical/societal issues and solutions (1.25 marks) (g) AI usage (Students must submit a 150–200 word paragraph explaining how AI tools were used. A screenshot demonstrating AI usage is required.) (1.5 marks) Option 2 (For constructivism approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal
assessments.Note: According to the predetermined LOs, lecturers have the flexibility to choose assignment forms. Each assignment has a six-day due date, which commences when the lecture provides detailed instructions.

assessments.Question Type: Develop a strategic communication plan for a brand/campaign including: - Objectives - Strategies - Tactics - Timeline - Budget - Stakholders - Evaluation
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: "- Possess the necessary skills and abilities to develop and implement effective public relations plans for a wide range of entertainment activities. - Use AI to generate campaign objectives, build a timeline template, and create creative visual demos for communication plans, such as: storyboard, print ad, TVC."
assessments.Grading Guide: Written report (a) Suggested criteria for grading written reports - Research and understand the business/brand (1 mark) - Objectives (1 mark) - Strategies (1 mark) - Tactics (1 mark) - Timeline (0.75 marks) - Budget (0.75 marks) - Stakeholders (0.5 marks) - Evaluation (0.5 marks) - AI usage (Students must submit a 150–200 word paragraph explaining how AI tools were used. A screenshot demonstrating AI usage is required.) (1 mark) (b)Suggested criteria for grading oral presentations (1.5 marks) - Well explain the AI usage during the assignment (0.5 marks) - Quality of Presentation Slides and Multimedia (0.3 marks) - Well explain their proposal/intention/ideas (0.5 marks) - Time Management (0.2 marks) (c) Q&A (1 marks)
assessments.Note: According to the predetermined LOs, lecturers have the flexibility to choose assignment forms. Each assignment has a six-day due date, which commences when the lecture provides detailed instructions.
